description: Classical Townsend model behind Paschen's law: alpha/p = A exp(-B p/E), no attachment, no photons, gamma electrons per arriving ion. A and B are Raizer, Gas Discharge Physics (1991), Table 4.1; the defaults are air.

parameters._gamma0: Ion-induced secondary emission yield of the cathode
parameters._mu_e_N: Electron mobility times N [(m V s)^-1]
parameters._mu_ion_N: Ion mobility times N [(m V s)^-1]
